places.name: Knowsley Safari Park
places.priceInfo: Babies under 1: free. Toddlers/children and adults: paid, price varies by age and booking method — check official site for current pricing.
places.openingHours: Varies seasonally — typically 10:00 start, closing time 17:00–18:00 depending on season. Confirm current days/hours on the official site before visiting.

places.name: Yellow Sub Play Centre
places.priceInfo: Paid entry, priced per child by age band; check official site once reopened.
places.address: Dempster Buildings, Atlantic Way, Brunswick Business Park, Liverpool, L3 4BE
places.openingHours: Closed for refurbishment as of writing — expected to reopen Autumn 2026. Previously: 10am–6pm Tue–Sun, closed Mondays except school/bank holidays.

places.name: Croxteth Hall & Country Park
places.priceInfo: Country park: free. Farm: small charge per person, under-1s free. Hall/Walled Garden: separate paid admission when open.
places.address: Croxteth Hall Lane, Liverpool, L12 0HB (farm entrance via Muirhead Avenue, L11 1EH)
places.openingHours: Country park: daily, 7am–7pm (Apr–Oct) / 7am–5:30pm (Nov–Mar). Farm: daily 10am–5pm, last entry 4pm. Hall & Walled Garden: seasonal, roughly late March–late September — check before visiting.

places.name: Wirral Country Park (Thurstaston)
places.priceInfo: Free entry. Small charge for car parking.
places.address: Wirral Country Park Visitor Centre, Station Road, Thurstaston, Wirral, CH61 0HN
places.openingHours: Country park open daily, 24 hours. Visitor centre, cafe and toilets: 10am–4:30pm (Apr–Sep) / 10am–3:30pm (Oct–Mar), closed Christmas Day.

places.name: World Museum Liverpool
places.priceInfo: Free entry. Small charge for planetarium shows and some special exhibitions.
places.openingHours: Tuesday–Sunday 10:00–17:00 (last admission ~16:30). Closed Mondays, except during school holidays. Closed Christmas Day, Boxing Day and New Year's Day.
